micah.4.p1.b1.text: In the last days the mountain of the house of the LORD will be established as the chief of the mountains … the peoples will stream to it.

micah.4.p1.b2.text: Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob.

micah.4.p1.b3.text: they will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will no longer take up the sword against nation, nor will they train anymore for war.

micah.4.p1.b4.text: And each man will sit under his own vine and under his own fig tree, with no one to frighten him.

micah.4.p1.b5.text: For the mouth of the LORD of Hosts has spoken.

micah.4.p1.b6.text: Though each of the peoples may walk in the name of his god, yet we will walk in the name of the LORD our God forever and ever.

micah.4.p2.b1.text: “On that day,” declares the LORD, “I will gather the lame; I will assemble the outcast, even those whom I have afflicted.”

micah.4.p2.b2.text: And you, O watchtower of the flock, O stronghold of the Daughter of Zion— the former dominion will be restored to you

micah.4.p2.b3.text: Writhe in agony, O Daughter of Zion, like a woman in labor. … You will go to Babylon; there you will be rescued

micah.4.p2.b4.text: Let her be defiled, and let us feast our eyes on Zion.

micah.4.p2.b5.text: Rise and thresh, O Daughter of Zion

micah.4.p2.b6.text: I will give you horns of iron and hooves of bronze
